name: Banking
vision: Customers hold accounts, accounts move money, and every movement is a transfer that can fail halfway. The domain that has to get it right twice — once in the rules, once in the recovery.

aggregates.name: Customer
aggregates.description: A person the bank holds a relationship with. Suspended rather than deleted — a bank forgets nothing.

commands.name: Register
commands.goal: Take on a new customer

commands.name: Suspend
commands.goal: Stop a customer transacting while something is investigated

commands.name: Reinstate
commands.goal: Let a cleared customer transact again

commands.name: Close
commands.goal: End the relationship

queries.name: InGoodStanding
queries.description: The everyday customer roll — active, and nothing outstanding against them.

queries.name: Suspended
queries.description: The compliance queue, newest concern first.

queries.name: NotGoodStanding
queries.description: Everyone who is not in the everyday roll — suspended, under review, or anything else that is not simply "good".

aggregates.name: Account
aggregates.description: A balance belonging to one customer, and the ledger that explains how it got there.

invariants.description: a currency is a three-letter code
a currency is a three-letter code

commands.name: Open
commands.goal: Give a customer somewhere to keep money

commands.name: Credit
commands.goal: Put money in

commands.name: Debit
commands.goal: Take money out, if it is there to take

ensures.description: the balance fell by exactly the amount
no debit leaves the balance negative

commands.name: Freeze
commands.goal: Stop an account moving while something is investigated

commands.name: Unfreeze
commands.goal: Release a cleared account

commands.name: CloseAccount
commands.goal: Close an account that has been emptied

givens.description: a correction cannot exceed collected fees
a correction cannot exceed accrued interest
the balance covers an interest correction

entities.name: LedgerEntry
entities.description: One movement across the account, in the order it was posted.

commands.name: Amend
commands.goal: Correct a movement posted for the wrong amount

givens.description: an amendment leaves a non-negative amount

commands.name: Reverse
commands.goal: Undo a movement that should not have been posted

queries.name: Reversed
queries.description: Entries that were undone — the audit trail nobody wants to need.

queries.name: Open
queries.description: Accounts that can transact today.

queries.name: Overdrawn
queries.description: Accounts below a floor the caller supplies — the morning risk report.

queries.name: HighBalance
queries.description: Accounts holding at least a floor the caller supplies — the private-banking referral list.

queries.name: StrictlyAbove
queries.description: Accounts holding MORE than a floor the caller supplies — the referral list without the accounts sitting exactly on the line.

queries.name: AtMost
queries.description: Accounts holding no more than a cap the caller supplies — the small-balance closure candidates.

queries.name: Reachable
queries.description: Accounts that still exist as far as a caller is concerned — anything short of closed.

queries.name: OpenForSuspendedCustomers
queries.description: Open accounts whose customer has since been suspended — live money movement nobody should be approving right now.

queries.name: OpenForCustomer
queries.description: One customer's own open accounts — the for_each target that freezes every one of them on suspension, not just whichever the event payload happened to carry.

aggregates.name: ATMCard
aggregates.description: A card issued against an account, and the cash taken with it.

commands.name: Issue
commands.goal: Put a card in a customer's hand

commands.name: Rename
commands.goal: Name a card so it is recognisable

commands.name: Withdraw
commands.goal: Take cash out at a machine

commands.name: Activate
commands.goal: Start using a card

commands.name: Retire
commands.goal: Take a card out of service

entities.name: Withdrawal
entities.description: One handful of cash, in the order it was taken.

commands.name: Dispute
commands.goal: Challenge a withdrawal that was not mine

queries.name: Recent
queries.description: The first two withdrawals still standing, whatever else was taken.

queries.name: Active
queries.description: Live cards in nickname order — a card nobody named sorts before every card that has one.

queries.name: ByFee
queries.description: Live cards by what they cost to hold, cheapest first — a fee is a Float, so the order is numeric and not alphabetical.

aggregates.name: Transfer
aggregates.description: Money leaving one account for another. Two movements that must both happen, or neither.

commands.name: Request
commands.goal: Send money to another account

commands.name: Debited
commands.goal: Record that the source account has given up the money

commands.name: Settle
commands.goal: Record that the destination has received it

commands.name: Credited
commands.goal: Record that the destination credit committed

commands.name: Reverse
commands.goal: Put the money back when the credit could not be made

commands.name: Reject
commands.goal: Refuse a transfer before any money moved

queries.name: InFlight
queries.description: Transfers that have left one account and not arrived at the other. The list that must always empty.

aggregates.name: CardPayment
aggregates.description: A card authorisation that either settles, is voided before settlement, or becomes a post-settlement dispute.

invariants.description: a tag is not the empty string

commands.name: Dispute
commands.goal: Challenge a payment that already settled

queries.name: Flagged
queries.description: Charges carrying a risk tag, for the fraud queue.

aggregates.name: ExternalTransfer
aggregates.description: A transfer sent beyond the bank, where a recall is an instruction and a return is the external network's outcome.

invariants.description: an external transfer amount is positive

aggregates.name: ScheduledPayment
aggregates.description: An instruction held for a future date, which may execute once or be cancelled before it does.

invariants.description: a scheduled payment amount is positive
a payment due date is present

commands.name: Fail
commands.goal: Record that today's presentment could not be collected

commands.name: Retry
commands.goal: Re-present a failed payment, up to the limit the schedule names

ensures.description: a retry never lowers the attempt count

commands.name: Abandon
commands.goal: Give up on a payment that could not be collected after every retry

aggregates.name: SafeDepositBox
aggregates.description: A steel box in the vault, held under one customer's name and opened only against the branch and number stamped on its face.

invariants.description: a box is numbered from one

commands.name: Rent
commands.goal: Assign the box to a customer

commands.name: Surrender
commands.goal: Give the box back and take the keys off the account

givens.description: only a rented box is surrendered

commands.name: LogVisit
commands.goal: Record that the box was opened

givens.description: only a rented box is opened

commands.name: IssueKey
commands.goal: Cut a key for the box

entities.name: Visit
entities.description: One opening of the box, in the order it happened that day.

commands.name: Annotate
commands.goal: Note something unusual about a visit after the fact

queries.name: Recent
queries.description: The last few visits, whatever the box has seen.

entities.name: KeyIssuance
entities.description: One key cut for the box, held by whoever last signed for it.

commands.name: Return
commands.goal: Take a key back when a holder is done with it

givens.description: only an issued key is returned

queries.name: Rented
queries.description: Boxes currently assigned to a customer, for the annual access audit.

aggregates.name: OnboardingCase
aggregates.description: The KYC check a newly registered customer clears before an account exists for them — screened once, and if it does not clear there is nothing to undo, because nothing was ever opened.

commands.name: Open
commands.goal: Open a KYC case for a newly registered customer, naming the account it will become

commands.name: Clear
commands.goal: Pass a customer's identity and screening checks

commands.name: Decline
commands.goal: Refuse a customer who does not clear screening — no account was ever opened, so nothing is undone

queries.name: Screening
queries.description: Cases still waiting on a compliance decision.

aggregates.name: Statement
aggregates.description: A snapshot of one account's activity over one period, generated once and never revised.

commands.name: Generate
commands.goal: Close out one period's activity into a permanent record

read_models.name: CustomerPortfolio
read_models.description: A customer's cross-account position, rebuilt from aggregate heads.

read_models.name: ComplianceDashboard
read_models.description: One account, its own status, and any card charges disputed against it — the working set for a compliance review.

read_models.name: DisputedPaymentCount
read_models.description: How many of an account's own card charges are under dispute — a single number, not the rows themselves.

read_models.name: DisputedPaymentMedian
read_models.description: The median amount of an account's own disputed card charges.

read_models.name: AccountsByKind
read_models.description: Every account the bank holds, sorted into what kind it is, then by its own number.
